newsitem.title: UK: Northern falls,but higher bid still expected.
newsitem.headline: Northern falls,but higher bid still expected.

text.p: Shares in Northern electric fell below the 630 pence offer launched on Monday by CalEnergy, but analysts still expect the U.S. utility to raise its bid.
"It's quite likely they will come in and bid a bit more. I think they don't want a contested bid," said Arthur Hepher at Credit Lyonnais Laing.
Northern fell to 625 at one point, but then recovered to trade down 16-1/2 pence on the day at 631-1/21.
Analysts said shares were simply volatile without giving clear indications of market expectations.
"The volatility around bid is always on the back of little volume, said Chris Perry at Charterhouse Tilney.
"All I can say is that in all other cases, except for SWEB and Eastern where there was an agreed bid, contested bids had to be raised," he added.
